definitions.explanation: The first day of the year; a major holiday in Japan.

examples.japanese: {元日|がんじつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{初詣|はつもうで}→初詣：05804_hatsumoude⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I went to the first shrine visit of the year on New Year's Day.

examples.japanese: {元日|がんじつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{過|す}ごす→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: New Year's Day is often spent with family.

examples.japanese: {元日|がんじつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧、⟦おせち→おせち：noentry⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: On New Year's Day morning, we ate osechi (traditional New Year food).

examples.japanese: {元日|がんじつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{休日|きゅうじつ}→休日：03028_kyuujitsu⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: New Year's Day is a holiday.

examples.japanese: {元日|がんじつ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まる→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Some companies start work from New Year's Day.

notes:
{元日|がんじつ} specifically refers to January 1st, the first day of the year.

Related terms:
- {元旦|がんたん} (New Year's Day, particularly the morning)
- {正月|しょうがつ} (New Year, the New Year period)
- {大晦日|おおみそか} (New Year's Eve, December 31st)

Distinction:
- {元日|がんじつ} = January 1st (the day)
- {元旦|がんたん} = New Year's morning (strictly speaking)
- {正月|しょうがつ} = The New Year period (first few days)

New Year's traditions:
- {初詣|はつもうで} (first shrine visit)
- {年賀状|ねんがじょう} (New Year's cards)
- おせち{料理|りょうり} (traditional New Year dishes)
- お{雑煮|ぞうに} (New Year soup with mochi)
